title: Flat quasi-coherent finite-presentation sheaves are closed under retracts
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $M,N$ be $\mathcal O_S$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Suppose there are maps $i:M\to N$ and $r:N\to M$ with $r\circ i=\mathrm{id}_M$. If $N$ is flat over $\mathrm{id}_S$ [def-pc-scheme-module-flat-over], quasi-coherent [pqf-def-coherent], and of finite presentation [lem-weil-pbc-quasi-coherent-finite-type-affine], then $M$ has all three properties.

source.place: Tags 01PC and 00NX; direct summands via Mathlib Module.Projective.of_split and Module.Flat.of_retract

proof.text: Identify M with the kernel of id_N - i∘r. The kernel theorem makes M quasi-coherent. On every affine pair U⊆V, apply the section-evaluation functor followed by restriction of scalars to the retraction; Module.Flat.of_retract transfers flatness over Γ(S,V).

The affine finite-presentation criterion gives finite presentation of sections of N. At U=V its flatness and Module.Flat.projective_of_finitePresentation make these finite projective. Module.Projective.of_split transfers projectivity to sections of M; the surjective section retraction transfers finite generation. Module.finitePresentation_of_projective gives finite presentation of sections of M. Apply the affine criterion and locality on the cover by all affine opens.
